Day 27 — Current snapshot (last 6 hrs)

  • Active strikes: US launched a second night of strikes on Iranian military sites after a drone/ship incident. CENTCOM confirmed the strikes and released video.
  • Pause & talks: Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (until Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), claiming Iranian request and progress in talks. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Northern border / Lebanon: Hezbollah firing remains daily. Israel and Lebanon reported a new agreement that would require Hezbollah disarmament; implementation is uncertain. IDF told to prepare for extended deployment in Lebanon.
  • Israel / Gaza: Israeli strikes continue. IDF says strike killed a Hamas commander (relative of Ismail Haniyeh). Reports of displacement-tent strikes in Gaza: 2 killed, dozens injured.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran is selectively allowing passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others. Reports (AP) of an initial US–Iran deal to end the war and open the strait — contrasts with Tehran's denials.
  • Airspace & logistics: Major regional airports listed closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight traffic sharply reduced. Russian air defenses shot down two drones bound for Moscow.
  • Domestic politics: Netanyahu moves to form a 'broad national government' amid internal criticism.
  • 🟢 Good News: Reported Israel–Lebanon framework could, if enforced, limit Hezbollah's role on the northern front.
Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • פוליטיקה פנימית: נתניהו דוחף לממשלה לאומית רחבה תוך ביקורת פוליטית.

Day 27 — Situation Report

Active strikes/sirens:
  • US launched a fresh round of airstrikes on Iranian military sites tonight. CENTCOM confirmed the strikes and released video after a cargo ship was hit by a drone.
  • Iranian proxies (Hezbollah, Hamas) and Iran continue missile/rocket strikes toward Israel. Northern border active daily.
Diplomacy & pauses
  • Trump announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), citing an "Iranian government request". Iran denies direct talks.
  • First pause (Mar 23, five days) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — raises credibility risk for current pause.
  • Pakistan acting as intermediary in talks.
Strait of Hormuz & shipping
  • Iran opens Hormuz to ships from Russia, India, China; continues to block others. A merchant vessel was struck by a drone — prompted US reprisal strikes.
Northern border & Lebanon
  • Hezbollah attacks continue daily. Israel ordered troops to prepare for an extended deployment in Lebanon.
  • Reports say a Lebanon–Israel deal would require Hezbollah disarmament; Israel retains security-zone rights under the draft.
Airspace & logistics
  • Regional airports reported closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.
  • CENTCOM released footage of US strikes. Flight traffic low; limited military flights reported.
Other operational notes
  • IDF says strike killed an Oct. 7 Hamas commander (Wadi Haniyeh).
  • Civilian displacement and casualties reported in Gaza from ongoing strikes.
🟢 Good News
  • AP reports an initial US–Iran memorandum aiming to end fighting, ease some sanctions and reopen the Strait — talks reportedly ongoing despite conflicting strikes.
  • Draft Lebanon deal includes provisions to weaken Iranian axis in the north.
Threat assessment: Escalating

    • מחלוקות על נוסח ה־MoU עם עומאן וארה"ב.

    • סגירות מסלולים ותעופה אזרחית במדינות האזור: איראן, ישראל, עיראק, סוריה, לבנון, ירדן.
